item.summary: The firm discovered that certain units shipped to the U.S. retail stores only has "foreign languages" on the label. Product has undeclared wheat, soy, milk, eggs and tree nut (coconut). Product details: ERIDANOUS GREEK STYLE Shortbread Cookies with Chocolate Truffle Coating & Apricot Filling. Product is packed onto a plastic carton tray with outer paper sleeve, 330 g (weight), UPC: 4056489125839.
item.affectedPeople: Product was shipped to the following states: DC, DE, GA, MD, NJ, NY, NC, PA, SC, & VA.
